tasks.title: Backend: Add findAllWithIssueInfo to CoderSessionRepo
tasks.description: Add a new method `findAllWithIssueInfo(projectId, status?, limit?)` to CoderSessionRepo that joins coder_session with issues table and uses a correlated subquery on workflow_log to derive lastActivityAt. Returns array of session objects with issue info (number, title, stage) and lastActivityAt.
acceptanceCriteria: findAllWithIssueInfo returns sessions with issueNumber, issueTitle, issueStage, lastActivityAt fields

Results ordered by createdAt descending
Typecheck passes

tasks.title: Frontend: Implement useActivityCards hook with SSE subscriptions
tasks.description: Create useActivityCards hook that initializes from useAgentSessions() and useAgentStatus(), then subscribes to SSE events via onAgentEvent() to update card state in-place. Manages SessionCardMap (keyed by issueNumber), activity previews (max 3), task progress, and Waiting cards. Uses useRef+useState pattern with RAF throttling for text chunks.
acceptanceCriteria: Hook returns { activeCards, recentCards, waitingCards, statusCounts, slotUsage }
coder_session_started adds card to activeCards
coder_session_completed moves card from active to recentCards
coder_text_chunk updates activity preview on matching card (max 80 chars, merged consecutive chunks)
coder_tool_call updates activity preview with tool title
ralph_task_update updates taskProgress { completed, total } on matching card
agent_paused adds to waitingCards with 'Needs Approval' label
question_asked adds to waitingCards with 'Question Pending' label
question_answered removes from waitingCards
Activity previews capped at 3 entries per card
RAF throttling applied to coder_text_chunk events (100ms batch)
Typecheck passes
Build passes
tasks.notes: See design.md D2, D3, D5. Follow onAgentEvent pattern from useSessionTimeline.ts.

tasks.title: Frontend: Implement SessionCard components (Active, Waiting, Recent)
tasks.description: Create ActiveSessionCard, WaitingCard, and RecentCard components. ActiveSessionCard shows issue number+title, task description, stage label, model, live duration timer, last 3 activity previews, task progress bar, and anomaly badges. WaitingCard shows issue info and reason (approval/question). RecentCard shows issue info, status, and completion time. All cards are clickable and navigate to /issue/:number.
acceptanceCriteria: ActiveSessionCard displays issue number, title, task description, stage label, model name
ActiveSessionCard shows running duration updated every second
ActiveSessionCard shows last 3 activity previews
ActiveSessionCard shows progress bar when taskProgress is set, hidden when null
WaitingCard displays 'Needs Approval' or 'Question Pending' label with truncated question preview
RecentCard displays completed/failed status icon and completion time
Clicking any card navigates to /issue/:number
Cards are responsive (single column on mobile)
Typecheck passes
Build passes
tasks.notes: Duration timer driven by parent's setInterval(1000) render counter. See design.md D7.

tasks.title: Frontend: Add anomaly detection badges
tasks.description: Add anomaly badge rendering to session cards. Compute anomalies client-side: running >30min, idle >5min (lastActivityAt stale), unanswered question >10min. Use setInterval(30s) to re-evaluate conditions. Badges are visually prominent but not disruptive. Multiple anomalies show on same card.
acceptanceCriteria: Card shows 'Running >30min' badge when createdAt is >30 minutes ago
Card shows 'No activity >5min' badge when lastActivityAt is >5 minutes ago
Waiting card shows 'Unanswered >10min' badge when question is >10 minutes old
Multiple anomalies display simultaneously on same card
Idle badge disappears when new activity arrives
Badges re-evaluate every 30 seconds via setInterval
Typecheck passes
Build passes
tasks.notes: See design.md D4. Pure client-side computation, no backend involvement.
